kindHints.manual: The new unit cost replaces the current one for the stock on hand at the date.

revaluations.postHint: Posting moves the difference between the inventory account and the write-down account, and re-applies any movements after the date.
revaluations.emptyDescription: Write stock down when it can no longer be sold at cost, or revalue it by hand.

slowMoving.description: Stock on hand that has not been sold or consumed for a while, the longest idle first. Moves between warehouses, adjustments and counts do not count as use.
slowMoving.summary: {lines, plural, =0 {Nothing idle that long} one {# line idle} other {# lines idle}}
slowMoving.emptyDescription: Every item with stock was sold or used within the period chosen.

valuation.description: What the stock is worth at any date by item and warehouse, equal to the inventory accounts; the cost runs the engine made.
valuation.emptyDescription: No stock is valued for these filters at this date.

workflow.inboxDescription: What waits for your decision: why it needs approval, which rule, which values, and everything that happened so far.
workflow.definitionsDescription: Who approves what: rules written against a document's fields, the steps each rule requires, and the blocks a module routes here.
workflow.commentPlaceholder: Say why (required to reject or request changes)
workflow.emptyInboxDescription: Requests assigned to you, or delegated to you, appear here.
workflow.emptyDelegationsDescription: A delegation lets another member decide in your place between two dates.
workflow.name: Name
workflow.conditionHelp: Fields: {fields}. Functions: {functions}. Example: amount_in('USD') > 10000 and category in ('capex', 'opex')
workflow.conditionValid: The condition is valid and uses: {fields}
workflow.emptyDefinitionsDescription: Without an active definition, documents post without approval (or with the company setting's manual approval).

partners.suppliersDescription: Who the company buys from: the partner record, its contacts, addresses, bank accounts and registrations, and the terms, tolerances and holds that purchasing reads.
partners.settingsDescription: What supplier accounts draw on: payment terms with instalments, delivery terms, supplier groups and withholding tax codes.
partners.search: Search by code, name or email
partners.name: Name
partners.emptySuppliersDescription: Register the first supplier of this company: a partner record and its terms.
partners.businessDaysOnly: Move to the next working day
partners.instalmentsHelp: Optional: percentages sum to 100; each line's days count from the base date.
partners.previewHelp: Due dates for an invoice of the amount on the date, in the company's calendar.

statement.title: Statement
statement.chooseSupplier: Choose a supplier to see their statement.
statement.empty: Nothing was booked for this supplier up to the end of the period.

payables.description: What is owed per supplier: invoice instalments, debit notes, advances and payments on account; aged at any date from the items and their settlements; held, applied and unapplied.
payables.emptyItemsDescription: Post a supplier invoice to open the first item.
payables.unappliedReason: Unapplied from the open item screen
payables.proposalsDescription: What to pay by a date in one currency: unheld invoices due by then and those whose early-payment discount is still open; edited line by line, approved, then drafted into payments per supplier.
payables.emptyProposalsDescription: Propose what is due by a date.

banking.accountsDescription: Bank, cash and petty-cash accounts, each on its own control account with its movements as the subledger.
banking.emptyAccounts: No bank or cash accounts yet
banking.emptyAccountsDescription: Create the account payments go out of.
banking.name: Name
banking.paymentsDescription: Supplier payments and advances: invoices settled at their booked value, early-payment discounts and tax withheld at payment, bank charges and the exchange difference; the rest stays on account.
banking.emptyPaymentsDescription: Pay a supplier's open invoices or record an advance.
banking.exchangeRateHelp: The spot rate of the day unless given.
banking.receiptsDescription: Customer receipts and deposits: invoices settled at their booked value, the early-payment discount given and the tax the customer withheld, the bank's charges and the exchange difference; the rest stays on account.
banking.emptyReceiptsDescription: Collect a customer's open invoices or record a deposit.
banking.withheldByCustomerHelp: The code whose rate the customer deducted from what they paid.

intelligence.description: How suppliers perform, from the documents as they stand: a scorecard with configurable weights, the days from order to receipt, and the prices paid and quoted.
intelligence.nothingToScore: No receipts or invoices in this window.

analysis.description: What was bought over a period: approved orders at the net order price in the company's currency, with how much has been received and invoiced.
analysis.empty: Nothing was ordered in this period.
analysis.legend: Each bar is the row's ordered value against the largest row; the darker part is what has been received. Cancelled quantities and orders not yet approved are left out.

openLines.description: What is still to arrive from suppliers: approved, sent and partly received order lines with goods open, valued at the net order price; late lines are flagged.
openLines.daysLate: {count, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}
openLines.summary: {lines, plural, =0 {No open lines} one {# open line} other {# open lines}}, {late, plural, =0 {none late} one {# late} other {# late}}
openLines.emptyDescription: Approved orders with goods still to receive appear here.

purchasing.returnsDescription: Goods sent back to the supplier from a posted receipt at the exact cost they came in with; GRNI carries the return until the supplier's debit note credits it; reversible while nothing has been credited.
purchasing.emptyReturnsDescription: Send back quantities of a posted receipt.
purchasing.nothingReturnable: Nothing of this receipt is left to return.
purchasing.chooseReceipt: Choose a posted receipt to see its lines.
purchasing.applyCreditHelp: Settle an open invoice of the same supplier with this debit note.
purchasing.landedCostsDescription: Freight, customs, duties, insurance and handling allocated to posted receipts by value, weight, volume or quantity: what is still on hand takes its share, what was already sold goes to cost of sales; estimates sit on the clearing account until the charge invoices settle them.
purchasing.emptyLandedCostsDescription: Land the charges of a shipment on its receipts.
purchasing.nothingAllocatable: No posted receipt lines to land on.
purchasing.invoicesDescription: Supplier invoices matched to receipts (three-way) and to service lines (two-way) or entered as expenses: breaches beyond the supplier's tolerances are blocked until an override, approval follows the workflow, posting settles GRNI, re-prices the stock, withholds tax and opens the payables.
purchasing.emptyInvoicesDescription: Enter the supplier's invoice against its receipts, its service lines or as an expense.
purchasing.nothingInvoicable: Nothing left to invoice for this supplier.
purchasing.notMatchedYet: Not matched yet; submit the invoice.
purchasing.noPayables: No payables until the invoice is posted.
purchasing.receiptsDescription: Goods received against purchase orders: within the supplier's tolerance, into stock at the expected cost with GRNI as the offset, reversed as a whole when they were wrong.
purchasing.emptyReceiptsDescription: Receive the open lines of an approved order.
purchasing.nothingReceivable: Nothing left to receive on this order.
purchasing.chooseOrder: Choose an order to see its open lines.
purchasing.requisitionsDescription: What departments need: lines with an item, a quantity, an estimate and a suggested supplier, approved through the workflow, then ordered per supplier.
purchasing.rfqsDescription: Lines sent to invited suppliers for pricing; quotes recorded, compared by landed price in the company's currency then lead time, and one awarded into a purchase order.
purchasing.ordersDescription: Purchase orders in the supplier's currency: submitted through the workflow, sent by email, changed through revisions that keep the previous version, cancelled or closed.
purchasing.agreementsDescription: Blanket agreements: agreed quantities and prices per item for a period; purchase orders release against them and never past the cap.
purchasing.noLines: No lines yet; add the first.
purchasing.emptyRequisitionsDescription: Raise the first requisition for what a department needs.
purchasing.emptyAgreementsDescription: Agree quantities and prices with a supplier for a period.
purchasing.committedAmountHelp: Zero leaves the value uncapped; only the line quantities cap releases.
purchasing.dropShipNoteFor: Drop-ship for sales order {number}: ships straight to the customer.
purchasing.emptyOrdersDescription: Draft an order for a supplier, or create one from an approved requisition.
purchasing.noCommitments: No commitments until the order is approved.
purchasing.sendToHelp: Blank sends to the supplier's email address.
purchasing.emptyRfqsDescription: Send lines to suppliers and compare what they quote.
purchasing.title: Title
purchasing.comparisonNote: Ranked by landed total in {currency} at the spot rate of {date}, then by lead time.

analysis.description: Every line of the company's invoices and credit notes in the period, with thirty-odd fields to group, filter and sum by: customer, item, rep, month, category, branch and more. Credit notes count against. Double-click a line to open its invoice.
analysis.truncated: Only the first {count} lines are shown; narrow the period.
analysis.empty: No invoice lines in this period
analysis.emptyDescription: Post an invoice, or widen the period or the documents shown.

sales.customersDescription: Who the company sells to: each customer's account with its terms, rep and credit. Open one for its 360.
sales.pipelineDescription: Every open deal by stage, weighted by how likely it is to close. Drag a deal to another stage or use its menu.
sales.activitiesDescription: Calls, meetings, emails and tasks: what is late, what is coming, and what was done.
sales.setupDescription: Customer groups, the sales team and how it is paid, and the stages every deal moves through.
sales.memberHint: The member who is this rep, so their customers and deals show as theirs.
sales.creditLimitHint: In the company's currency. Leave empty for no limit.
sales.overdueBlockDaysHint: New orders are held once an invoice is this many days late. Leave empty for no block.
sales.creditReadOnly: Credit settings are kept by credit control.
sales.emptyCustomersDescription: Register the first customer of this company: a partner record and its account.
sales.customerNotFoundDescription: It does not exist, or it belongs to a company you cannot see.
sales.noClosedDeals: Nothing closed in the last 12 months.
sales.noAccounts: No customer account yet: a prospect.
sales.openAccountHint: No account in {company} yet. Fill in the terms and open one.
sales.noTransactionsDescription: Balances and documents appear here as the modules that hold them record them.
sales.title: Title
sales.inStageFor: {count, plural, =0 {in stage since today} one {# day in stage} other {# days in stage}}
sales.subject: Subject
sales.commissionExplained: Rates are marginal: each band of a rep's sales in the period earns its own rate, and the most specific rates for a sale's item category and customer group apply.
sales.repsCount: {count, plural, =0 {no reps} one {# rep} other {# reps}}
sales.tryPlanTitle: What would a sale earn under {plan}?
sales.periodToDate: Rep's sales so far this period
sales.periodToDateHint: Where in the bands this sale starts.
sales.systemStage: A default stage: its code and outcome stay.
sales.quotationsDescription: Priced and taxed for a customer, sent, accepted or rejected; an accepted quotation converts to an order with its lines frozen exactly as quoted.
sales.ordersDescription: Confirmed orders reserve stock line by line (a short line backorders) and check the customer's credit; a drop-ship line skips reservation and is fulfilled by a purchase order instead.
sales.emptyQuotationsDescription: Quote a customer: price and tax its lines, then send it.
sales.emptyOrdersDescription: Take an order directly, or convert an accepted quotation.
sales.purchaseOrderLineIdPlaceholder: Paste the purchase order line's ID
sales.shipmentsDescription: A confirmed order's reserved lines, shipped in full or in part: the stock engine moves the stock and books cost of goods sold.
sales.emptyShipmentsDescription: Ship a confirmed order's reserved lines, in full or in part.
sales.noShippableLines: Nothing on this order is reserved and ready to ship.

invoicing.description: Invoices and credit notes: lines picked from what was shipped or ordered, or typed as items and services; posted to revenue, tax and the customer's receivable; deferred, commissioned and cleared where the setup says so.
invoicing.emptyDescription: Invoice a posted shipment, an order with service lines, or start one from scratch.
invoicing.customerReferenceHint: Their purchase order or reference, printed on the invoice.
invoicing.currencyHelp: The customer's currency; the receivable is kept in it.
invoicing.nothingInvoicable: This customer has nothing posted or ordered that is still to be invoiced.
invoicing.nothingCreditable: This customer has no posted invoice lines left to credit.
invoicing.noReceivables: No open items: the invoice is not posted yet.
invoicing.noCommission: No commission was accrued on this invoice.
invoicing.noScheme: The regime names no e-invoicing scheme.
invoicing.einvoiceHelp: Submit the posted invoice to the scheme; the status and QR come back from it.
invoicing.recurringDescription: Invoices issued on a schedule: the customer's items and services, on the cron you set in the company's time zone, posted at once or left as drafts to review.
invoicing.emptyRecurringDescription: Set up a subscription, retainer or rent to be invoiced on a schedule.
invoicing.scheduleHint: A cron expression: minute, hour, day, month, weekday.
invoicing.autoPost: Post each invoice as it is issued
invoicing.nothingIssued: No invoice has been issued from this schedule yet.

returns.description: Goods a customer sends back: requested against posted shipment lines, authorised, received into stock at the cost they left with, inspected and dispositioned, credited against the invoices that billed them.
returns.emptyDescription: Request a return of a customer's posted shipment lines, or use "Return goods" on a posted shipment.
returns.nothingReturnable: Nothing of this customer's posted shipments is left to return.
returns.chooseCustomer: Choose the customer to see what can come back.

pricing.priceListsDescription: Each company's prices by item, unit and quantity, in a currency, for the customers and groups they are for. A list can take its prices from another list, adjusted and rounded.
pricing.rulesDescription: What was agreed with customers, the discounts that apply by rule, promotions over the basket, and the floors no price may go under.
pricing.priceCheckDescription: Price a basket for a customer on a date exactly as a quote or an order will, and see why every line costs what it does.
pricing.name: Name
pricing.currencyHint: Empty: the customer's account currency, else the company's.
pricing.priorityHint: Lower numbers are looked at first.
pricing.adjustmentHint: For example -8 for 8% under the parent.
pricing.surchargeHint: For example -0.01 for prices ending in .99.
pricing.forWhomHint: A list for nobody in particular is used when a document names it or when it is the company's default.
pricing.forDocumentsOrDefault: Documents that name it, or everyone as the default
pricing.emptyListsDescription: Create the company's default list first; customer and group lists can derive from it.
pricing.fromQuantityHint: The quantity break: this price applies from this quantity of the unit.
pricing.inheritsAll: No prices of its own: every price comes from {parent}.
pricing.adjustHint: Every price of this list changes by the percentage, rounded to the step if one is given (a yearly increase).
pricing.combinationHint: Exclusive discounts compete and the best for the customer wins; stackable ones apply one after the other.
pricing.couponHint: Optional: the promotion then applies only when the code is given.
pricing.getDiscountPct: Off what is given, % (100 is free)
pricing.floorsHint: The lowest price or margin an item, or every item of a category, may sell at. A breach blocks the document for approval or warns.
pricing.calculateFailed: The basket could not be priced.
pricing.floorBlocks: A price is under its floor
pricing.unpriced: {count, plural, one {# line not priced} other {# lines not priced}}

detail.volume: {first} bought, the first tier starts at {second}
detail.cost_unknown: no cost yet, margin not checked

pricing.no_price: No price list, agreement or list price prices this item for this customer on this date.
pricing.rate_missing: An exchange rate the price needs is missing for this date.
pricing.tax_basis_mismatch: The price found is on the other tax basis than the document, and the item has no tax rate for this customer to convert it with.
pricing.uom_not_item_unit: The unit is not one of the item's units.
pricing.quantity_not_positive: The quantity must be greater than zero.

quantity.not_exact_in_base: The quantity is not a whole number of the item's base unit.

tax.setupDescription: Country tax templates, regimes with their codes, rates and determination matrix, item and partner tax groups, company registrations and customer exemption certificates.
tax.returnsDescription: The return computed from the tax ledger for a period, reconciled to the tax accounts of the general ledger, with drill-down to every entry and filing that locks the period.
tax.name: Name
tax.selectRegime: Select a regime to see its codes and determination matrix.
tax.selectCompanyAndRegime: Select a company and a regime to preview its return.

picking.description: The warehouse's picking work: lists released from shipments, in walking order, with who has each and how far they got.
picking.emptyDescription: Release a draft shipment for picking and its pick list appears here.
picking.readyToPost: Every line is picked: post it to ship what was picked.
picking.takeBackReason: Why take it back from the warehouse?

scanner.title: Pick
scanner.description: Take a pick list and walk it: scan the bin, the item and each serial, then confirm what you took.
scanner.offline: Picking checks the stock on the shelf, so it needs a connection.
scanner.noneDescription: Pick lists released for this warehouse appear here.
scanner.loadFailed: The pick list could not be loaded.
scanner.allPickedHint: {picked} of {planned} picked. The office can now post the shipment.
scanner.otherLotHint: Leave empty if you took lot {lot}.

receivables.description: What each customer owes: invoice instalments, credit notes, deposits and receipts on account; aged at any date from the items and their settlements; held, applied and unapplied.
receivables.emptyItemsDescription: Post a sales invoice to open the first item.

statement.chooseCustomer: Choose a customer to see their statement.
statement.empty: Nothing was booked for this customer up to the end of the period.

promise.title: Promised by
promise.hint: Leave empty to clear; dunning leaves the item alone until the date passes.

netting.hint: An open invoice of the same partner as a supplier, in this currency; the smaller remainder by default.

dunning.title: Dunning
dunning.noLevels: No dunning levels yet: add the first rung of the ladder.
dunning.daysOverdueHint: An item this many days late reaches the level.
dunning.blockCustomer: Put the customer on credit hold
dunning.nothingDue: No customer has an overdue item that climbs a level on that date.

codes.suggest: Fill in the next free code
codes.suggested: Filled in automatically; you can change it.

quick.hint: Just what the record needs now; the rest can be completed on its own screen later.

expenses.description: Supplier bills without an order, employee claims and petty cash vouchers: recorded with their date and lines, confirmed into the books, paid on their own date.
expenses.emptyExpensesDescription: Record the first expense with its date and lines.
expenses.employeeHelp: A partner marked as an employee; the claim is owed to them until it is paid.
expenses.currencyHelp: Blank: the company's currency. A petty cash voucher is in its fund's currency.
expenses.categoriesDescription: What an expense is for: the account each category lands on in every company's chart, its usual tax code, whether a receipt is required and the most a line may carry.
expenses.emptyCategoriesDescription: Create the categories expenses are recorded under.
expenses.accountCodeHelp: The code of the expense account; resolved in each company's chart when an expense is confirmed.
expenses.taxCodeHelp: Applied to the lines of this category unless a line names its own.
expenses.maxAmountHelp: A line above this amount is refused.
expenses.fundsDescription: Cash boxes with their float: vouchers spend them, a replenishment from the bank brings them back to the float; every movement sits in the bank subledger.
expenses.emptyFundsDescription: Create a fund on a cash box to pay small expenses from.
expenses.cashBoxHelp: A cash or petty cash account of the company; one fund per box.
expenses.floatHelp: The amount the fund is brought back to when replenished.

fixedAssets.description: The register: every asset with its cost, depreciation and net book value; activate, add to, impair, revalue, transfer, verify and dispose of each from its own page.
fixedAssets.emptyAssetsDescription: Record the first asset with its category, cost and dates.
fixedAssets.inServiceHelp: Depreciation starts from this date; blank means the acquisition date.
fixedAssets.taxHelp: Recoverable tax is booked as input tax; tax that cannot be recovered is capitalised.
fixedAssets.openingThroughHelp: The last month of the opening balances; the asset posts on the day after.
fixedAssets.quantityHelp: Units in this asset, for partial disposals.
fixedAssets.salvagePctHelp: Percent of cost kept at the end of the life.
fixedAssets.conventionHelp: How the first and last month count.
fixedAssets.ratePctHelp: Percent a year on the net book value; blank takes 150 % of straight line.
fixedAssets.newLifeHelp: Blank keeps the life that is left.
fixedAssets.custodianHelp: A custodian change alone posts nothing.
fixedAssets.categoriesDescription: What kind of asset: the defaults each one starts with (method, life, salvage, convention) and the accounts its postings land on in every company's chart.
fixedAssets.emptyCategoriesDescription: Create the categories assets are recorded under.
fixedAssets.accountsHelp: Account codes resolved in each company's chart; blank takes the chart's default for the role.
fixedAssets.booksDescription: One book per company posts to the ledger (created as MAIN with the first asset); memo books, such as a tax book, only compute their own depreciation.
fixedAssets.emptyBooksDescription: The ledger book is created with the first asset; add a tax book here.
fixedAssets.booksHelp: Whether a book posts to the ledger is fixed once assets are valued in it.
fixedAssets.depreciationDescription: Post a book through a month (one journal per run, catching up months left behind), reverse the latest run, see the plan by month and check the register against the ledger.
fixedAssets.throughHelp: Every planned month up to this date is posted.
fixedAssets.runHelp: The monthly schedule posts every ledger book on the first of the month.
fixedAssets.emptyRunsDescription: Activate assets, then post the first month.
fixedAssets.reconciliationHelp: The subledger's totals per control account; the harness compares them to the ledger asset by asset.

print.title: Print and send
print.renderFailed: The PDF could not be made.
print.previewFailed: The preview could not be made.
print.subject: Subject
print.subjectHelp: Blank takes the document's title and number.
print.emailHelp: The PDF goes attached; the send is logged on the document.
print.phoneHelp: With the country code; only the digits are kept.
print.whatsappMessage: Please find {number} at the link below.
print.whatsappHelp: Makes a link to the PDF that lives {days} days and opens WhatsApp with it in the message; the link opens without signing in.
print.whatsappReady: The link is ready. If WhatsApp did not open, use the button below; the link can also be copied.
print.linkHelp: A link to the PDF that opens without signing in; revoke it from the history.
print.linkOnce: The link is shown once; copy it now.
print.historyHelp: Every PDF, email and link made for this {type}; a final document's first PDF is kept as evidence.

templates.description: The layout each document prints with: the shipped templates and your copies of them, by company or branch; every edit of the HTML or CSS is a new version that can be previewed and rolled back.
templates.languageModeHelp: English, Arabic, or both side by side.
templates.scopeHelp: A template for one company (or one of its branches) wins over the one for all.
templates.emptyDescription: The shipped templates appear once a document type prints for the first time.
templates.versionHelp: Name, language, paper, scope, default and active change in place; new HTML or CSS becomes a new version.
templates.htmlHelp: The template language is Scriban (Liquid-like); the print model's fields are documented in the shipped template.
templates.noteHelp: What this version changes, for the version history.
templates.previewHelp: Rendered with the template's sample data, in the browser.
templates.copyHelp: A copy starts from the current version, for a company or a branch, and prints there instead of the shipped one once it is the default.
